2. Daily Summary

I visited the Grand West Crossing Buildings 3 & 4 job site today to supply Gabino's work area. I left the generator, gloves, a face mask, a chop saw, and two extension cords on site for the crew.

Gabino carried the generator into the building and set it down in his work area next to his tools. The work area is on the bare concrete slab inside the building, with a scissor lift parked nearby. Gabino had his PPE on at all times.
